2608.21087.title: Jokes Aside: Measuring the Semantic Distance of Double Meanings
2608.21087.paper_summary: Large language models have significantly enriched the toolkit for computational humor research, particularly in the automated generation of jokes and puns. A key innovation, contextual embedding vectors, offers new opportunities to revisit and refine earlier hypotheses. Notably, Petrovic and Matthews (2013) proposed a joke generation model based on the scheme "I like my X like I like my Y, Z" (e.g. "I like my ice like I like my dreams, crushed"). They suggested that joke hilarity increases with: a) frequent association of Z with X and Y, b) rarity of Z, c) ambiguity of Z, and d) meaning distance between X and Y. Building on this, Winters et al. (2019) proposed a set of metrics, based on Google Ngrams and Word2Vector. In this work, three out of their five metrics are revisited with word embeddings: obviousness, compatibility, and comparison. Another measure, symmetry, defined as closeness of Z to both X and Y, is introduced here for the first time. Two models were used to collect the embedding vectors (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small and MiniLM all-MiniLM-L6-v2) on three datasets: JokeJudger, Expunations, and rJokes. The last two datasets, Expunations, and rJokes, were expanded by adding paired sentences that captured the ambiguous expression at the core of each joke in its two different meanings. Results revealed that models trained on the proposed metrics performed poorly in predicting humor ratings: on JokeJudger, the best model achieved 57.1% accuracy, below the 61.5% baseline, while performance on Expunations and rJokes was even lower. Nevertheless, the symmetry metric seems consistently associated with higher-rated jokes, suggesting it may capture a necessary -though not sufficient- property of humor.
2608.21087.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型顯著豐富了計算幽默研究的工具箱，特別是在自動生成笑話和雙關語方面。關鍵創新，語境嵌入向量，提供了重新檢視和完善早期假設的新機會。值得注意的是，Petrovic 和 Matthews (2013) 提出了基於“我喜歡我的 X，就像我喜歡我的 Y，Z”的笑話生成模型（例如：“我喜歡我的冰，就像我喜歡我的夢，壓碎的”）。他們建議笑話的幽默程度隨著以下因素增加：a) Z 與 X 和 Y 的頻繁聯繫，b) Z 的稀有性，c) Z 的模糊性，以及 d) X 和 Y 之間的意義距離。在此基礎上，Winters 等人 (2019) 提出了一組基於 Google Ngrams 和 Word2Vector 的指標。在這項工作中，他們的五個指標中有三個使用了詞嵌入：明顯性、兼容性和比較性。另一個指標，對稱性，定義為 Z 與 X 和 Y 的接近程度，首次在此介紹。使用了兩個模型來收集嵌入向量（OpenAI text-embedding-3-small 和 MiniLM all-MiniLM-L6-v2），在三個數據集上進行：JokeJudger、Expunations 和 rJokes。最後兩個數據集，Expunations 和 rJokes，通過添加配對句子來擴展，這些句子捕捉了每個笑話核心的模糊表達及其兩種不同的含義。結果顯示，基於所提指標訓練的模型在預測幽默評分方面表現不佳：在 JokeJudger 上，最佳模型的準確率為 57.1%，低於 61.5% 的基準，而在 Expunations 和 rJokes 上的表現甚至更低。儘管如此，對稱性指標似乎與評分較高的笑話始終存在一致的關聯，這表明它可能捕捉到幽默的一個必要但不充分的特性。
